chunks.title: Standard Chartered Bank (Standard Chartered) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Standard Chartered Bank is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Senior Sustainable Finance Advisory speakers at COP31 Antalya; emerging markets blended & transition finance. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Emerging-market sustainable finance ($300B 2030 mobilization goal), blended adaptation finance, green trade & Article 6 carbon finance structuring. Source verification: https://cop.sifiratikvakfi.org/en/speakers/.

chunks.title: Standard Chartered Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Standard Chartered Bank provides the following climate financing instruments: Green & Transition Loan, Blended Finance Structuring, Green Trade Finance, Carbon Market Financing, Sustainable Bond. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 350,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Sovereign/Government.

chunks.title: Standard Chartered Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Standard Chartered Bank: Renewable Energy, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Industrial Decarbonization, Carbon Markets & Article 6, Sustainable Trade & Supply Chains. Target geographic focus includes: Emerging Markets, Asia, Africa, MENA, Türkiye, Global. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Standard Chartered Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Standard Chartered's application form: Standard Chartered Green & Sustainable Product Framework; Transition Finance Framework & credible decarbonization pathway; Emerging market ESG & Equator Principles screening; Second-Party Opinion / external assurance for labeled instruments. Explicit exclusion rules: Unabated coal expansion; Equator Principles breaches. Official application portal: https://www.sc.com/en/sustainability/sustainable-finance/.

chunks.title: Standard Chartered Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: Standard Chartered Bank uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.

chunks.title: Standard Chartered Guidance for 'Corporate Borrower & Operating Jurisdiction'

Borrower Overview' on Standard Chartered's Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake: Borrower entity, sector, and primary market. Required=True. Expected evidence keywords: Verified applicant facts. Align response with Standard Chartered's COP31 priorities (Senior Sustainable Finance Advisory speakers at COP31 Antalya; emerging markets blended & transition finance) and instruments (Green & Transition Loan, Blended Finance Structuring, Green Trade Finance).
